ads.label: Spec-led
ads.primary_text:
Waterproof membrane. Recycled rubber outsole. 4 mm lugs. 280 g.

Everything you need for wet miles, nothing you don't.

ads.label: Long story
ads.primary_text:
We spent two years testing outsoles on the wettest trails we could find. Most of them failed. One of them didn't, and it's on every pair we make this fall.

Take it for a walk in the worst weather you can find.
